# chordsym

> Chord symbols without dependencies: parse, pitch classes, key estimation, transposition


## Pages in this subsection

- [chordsym](chordsym.html.md): chordsym: chord symbols without dependencies — parse, pitch classes, keys, transposition.
- [chordsym.keys](chordsym.keys.html.md): What a chord does in a key: estimate a song’s key from its chords, label chords by function.
- [chordsym.parse](chordsym.parse.html.md): Read a chord symbol: is it one, what is its root and quality, which pitch classes it sounds.
- [chordsym.transpose](chordsym.transpose.html.md): Move chord symbols by semitones, spelled for the target key.
